details: The United States and Iran traded fire in the Strait of Hormuz on May 8, with Iran accusing the US of breaching an existing ceasefire. This development follows a period where Iran was reportedly considering a US peace proposal, which had previously contributed to a dip in global oil prices. The renewed clashes and persistent instability in the critical waterway, where both nations accuse each other of violations, are creating uncertainty in energy markets.
title: US-Iran Exchange Fire in Hormuz Amid Ceasefire Tensions

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) issued a warning on May 7, 2026, stating that advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools are escalating cyber threats and posing systemic risks to global financial stability. The IMF highlighted how AI, exemplified by models like "Claude Mythos," can rapidly identify and exploit vulnerabilities across interconnected financial systems, emphasizing the urgent need for increased resilience, supervision, and international coordination to mitigate these risks.
title: IMF Warns AI-Powered Cyberattacks Threaten Financial Stability
